selection: Original training-patient inner LOSO macro AP, independent for each matched ablation; original dev calibration only.
features: Reuse registered timebox_compact feature builder. Graph 4 numeric and graph-only phone interactions; auxiliary CF2 and isolated3 have shared slopes. No speaker identifiers as features.
loss: Speaker-equal pointwise logistic loss + 0.5 times speaker-equal within-patient positive-negative pairwise logistic loss + ridge penalty. Intercept unpenalized.
outer_evaluation: Parent evaluates all registered branches once after all predictions freeze; no tuning after new outer results.
